title: Rav Huna son of Moshe bar Atzri HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 174b: his father Moshe bar Atzri was guarantor for his daughter-in-law’s ketubah. Rav Huna his son was a Torah scholar and was in hard straits. Abaye said: “Is there no one to advise Rav Huna to divorce his wife, so that she will claim her ketubah from his father?” In the end it emerged that he was a Kohen. Abaye said: “This is what people say: poverty follows the poor.”
